package.description: Cooling and heating loads at the touch of a button.

en-US.description: Cooling and heating loads at the touch of a button.
en-US.longDescription: The System Design Load program calculates design cooling and heating loads for commercial buildings to facilitate HVAC system design. System Design Load advances the art of HVAC load estimating by introducing the concept of system-based design.
en-US.name: System Design Load

zh-CN.longDescription: System Design Load 程序专为商业建筑计算设计冷热负荷，助力暖通空调系统设计。通过引入基于系统的设计理念，该程序推动了暖通空调负荷估算技术的进步。
